programme.title: Eu, Alex Cross
programme.desc: Alex Cross é um detetive de homicídios de Detroit que vai ser levado a todos os limites físicos e morais qusndo tem de lidar com um assassino contratado que se especializa em dor e tortura.

programme.title: Força Da Natureza
programme.desc: Uma quadrilha de ladrões planeia um assalto num velho complexo de apartamentos de Porto Rico quando um grande furacão se abate sobre o local. Mas a tarefa vai ser complicada por um polícia que lá está destacado para evacuar o local e um ex-polícia ansioso por voltar ao ativo.

programme.title: Flag Day Dias Perdidos
programme.desc: Jennifer Vogel tenta superar os destroços do passado ao mesmo tempo que concilia o laço inescapável com o seu pai, que vive uma vida dupla de falsificador, assaltante de bancos e vigarista para a conseguir sustentar.

programme.title: O Último Viking
programme.desc: Um jovem viking chamado Vitharr chega à Britânia com sonhos de conquistas e aventuras, mas quando a sua família e o seu clã são emboscados e mortos, ele tem de sobreviver sozinho nesta terra estranha e perigosa.

programme.title: Abbé Pierre Uma Vida De Causas
programme.desc: A vida de Henri Grouès, conhecido por Abade Pierre, desde os seus tempos na Resistência durante a II Guerra Mundial até às suas batalhas contra a pobreza e pela defesa dos sem-abrigo.

programme.title: Mulher De Ouro
programme.desc: Maria Altmann, uma octogenária judia austríaca refugiada nos EUA, não se vai deter perante nada para recuperar os bens da sua família apreendidos pelos nazis, entre eles um famoso quadro de Gustav Klimt, missão em que será ajudada por um corajoso mas inexperiente advogado.

programme.title: Os Três Mosqueteiros
programme.desc: Ao lado de um jovem recruta ansioso por proteger o Rei de França, três leais espadachins tentam derrotar o pérfido conselheiro real e a sedutora espia enviada para derrubar a coroa.

programme.title: 13 Minutos
programme.desc: Quatro famílias numa cidade do centro dos EUA são testadas num único dia, quando um tornado devastador atinge a localidade. Quando a sirene toca, a comunidade tem apenas 13 minutos para chegar aos abrigos. Caminhos irão cruzar-se, vidas serão irreversivelmente alteradas, e a cidade será arrasada

programme.title: Gone - 12 Horas Para Viver
programme.desc: Jill Parrish está convencida que Molly, a sua irmã desaparecida, foi sequestrada pelo mesmo assassino em série de quem escapou no ano anterior. Mas será que Jill se encontra psicologicamente perturbada ou é a única que conhece a verdade, conseguindo encontrar Molly antes que seja tarde demais

programme.title: Pára, Ou A Mamã Dispara
programme.desc: Joe Bornowski, sargento da polícia de Los Angeles, vê a sua vida virada do avesso quando a sua adorável mãe chega à cidade para uma curta visita, testemunha um crime e envolve-se de tal maneira numa perigosa investigação policial que acaba por se tornar na sua parceira.

programme.title: Stargate
programme.desc: O arqueólogo Daniel Jackson descobre como fazer funcionar um portal estelar descoberto debaixo de uma pirâmide. O coronel Jonathan Jack ONeil recebe a missão de acompanhar Jackson e uma pequena equipa de soldados americanos através do stargate para explorar a galáxia desconhecida do outro lado.

programme.title: Cidade Dividida
programme.desc: Na cidade de Nova Iorque, Billy Taggart, um ex-polícia caído em desgraça trabalha como investigador particular e é contratado pelo presidente da câmara de Nova Iorque, a quem deve um enorme favor, para espiar a sua mulher.

programme.title: Soldado Implacável
programme.desc: No futuro, o sargento Todd, geneticamente alterado para ser uma arma de guerra mortífera, fica obsoleto. Deixado ao abandono num planeta de desperdício, ele integra-se numa comunidade pacífica mas volta a pegar em armas quando os novos soldados robotizados ameaçam eliminar essa colónia.

programme.title: Hércules - A Lenda Começa
programme.desc: Em 1200 a.C, na Grécia Antiga, o príncipe Hércules desconhece que é filho de Zeus e só deseja o amor da Princesa de Creta, prometida em casamento ao seu irmão. Agora, ele vai ter de fazer uma escolha fugir com o seu verdadeiro amor ou cumprir o seu destino e tornar-se o grande herói do seu tempo.

programme.title: Copshop Não Fazemos Prisioneiros
programme.desc: Em fuga de um assassino implacável, um astuto vigarista provoca distúrbios numa cidade pequena para ser preso e assim ficar escondido na esquadra da polícia. Só que o criminoso também acaba por ser preso numa cela próxima e a chegada de um terceiro assassino torna a situação ainda mais explosiva.

programme.title: Zona De Perigo
programme.desc: Abby Trent é uma agente da CIA que gere uma prisão clandestina de alto risco. Quando capturam Hatchet, o homem mais perigoso do mundo e um mestre na arte da fuga, ele inicia um jogo sangrento, eliminando os oficiais um a um. Abby descobre que está rodeada de traidores. Em quem pode confiar

programme.title: Os Ingleses Estão A Chegar
programme.desc: Harriet e Peter Fox são um casal de vigaristas ingleses que, após perderem uma grande soma ao póquer e ficarem a dever dinheiro a uma gangster psicótica, fogem para Los Angeles onde acabam por criar um elaborado plano para roubar um anel à rica ex-mulher de Peter.

programme.title: Serenidade
programme.desc: O passado misterioso do comandante de um navio de pesca regressa para o assombrar quando a sua ex-mulher insiste em abordá-lo com um desesperado pedido de ajuda, enredando a sua vida numa nova dimensão em que nada é o que parece.

programme.title: A Morte De Estaline
programme.desc: Moscovo, 2 de março de 1953. Após ter exercido um poder totalitário e absoluto por quase 30 anos, o ditador soviético Josef Stalin morre rápida e inesperadamente. Agora, os membros do conselho de ministros vão ter lutar para ocupar a liderança deixada vaga.

programme.title: Golpe De Amor
programme.desc: Quando Richard percebe que a sua empresa foi vendida a um empresário fraudulento e que os fundos de pensões de todos os funcionários desapareceram, decide juntar-se à ex-mulher para recuperar o dinheiro, numa aventura pela Europa que envolve perseguições loucas e roubo de joias.

programme.title: Uglydolls
programme.desc: Moxy é uma Ugly Doll que sonha com o dia em que encontrará a sua criança. Ela, e os seus amigos Wage, Babo e Ugly Bat, partem em busca do Instituto da Perfeição onde tudo farão para serem perfeitos. Mas esta aventura só os levará a perceber que o que nos faz únicos é sermos altamente imperfeitos

programme.title: Pára, Ou A Mamã Dispara
programme.desc: Joe Bornowski, sargento da polícia de Los Angeles, vê a sua vida virada do avesso quando a sua adorável mãe chega à cidade para uma curta visita, testemunha um crime e envolve-se de tal maneira numa perigosa investigação policial que acaba por se tornar na sua parceira.

programme.title: Soldado Implacável
programme.desc: No futuro, o sargento Todd, geneticamente alterado para ser uma arma de guerra mortífera, fica obsoleto. Deixado ao abandono num planeta de desperdício, ele integra-se numa comunidade pacífica mas volta a pegar em armas quando os novos soldados robotizados ameaçam eliminar essa colónia.

programme.title: Grudge Match - Ajuste De Contas
programme.desc: Henry Razor Sharp e Billy The Kid McDonnen são dois pugilistas rivais já retirados que decidem sair da reforma para um ultimo combate, trinta anos após o seu ultimo confronto no ringue.

programme.title: Preto Ou Branco
programme.desc: Elliott Anderson, recentemente viúvo, fica responsável por cuidar da neta mas é levado a tribunal pela avó paterna, que quer obter a custódia da criança, obrigando as duas famílias a confrontarem-se com os medos e convicções mais profundos no que respeita a raça, perdão e compreensão.

programme.title: Machete Mata
programme.desc: O governo dos EUA recruta Machete para uma missão no México para deter um revolucionário psicopata que quer lançar um míssil nuclear em Washington.

programme.title: Missão Inesperada
programme.desc: Jim Hanson, um ex-atirador de elite do exército, vive junto à isolada fronteira entre os EUA e o México e torna-se inesperadamente o protetor de um menino mexicano, quando um perigoso cartel de droga mata a mãe do rapaz e os começa a perseguir de forma implacável.

programme.title: O Corpo Da Mentira
programme.desc: Roger Ferris é um agente da CIA que descobre que um grande líder terrorista opera a partir da Jordânia. Quando concebe um plano para se infiltrar na sua rede, começa a questionar se os seus aliados não poderão interferir na operação e pôr a sua vida em risco.

programme.title: Sin City Mulher Fatal
programme.desc: Alguns dos cidadãos mais duros e resistentes da brutal metrópole que é Sin City cruzam-se com alguns dos seus habitantes mais sanguinários, em histórias de vingança e redenção.

programme.title: O Homem Do Tai Chi
programme.desc: O talento sem paralelo para o Tai Chi de um jovem perito em artes marciais vale-lhe a entrada num clube de combate do submundo altamente lucrativo.

programme.title: Works by Bach, Bartók, and Brahms
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra in an exciting concert program consisting of works by J. S. Bach, Béla Bartók, and Johannes Brahms. The program opens with Bach’s Brandenburg Concerto No. 3 in G major, BWV 1048. This is followed by one of Bartók’s best-known pieces: Music for strings, percussion and celesta.

programme.title: Piano works by Rachmaninoff, Beethoven And Glazunov
programme.desc: Russian pianist Nikolay Lugansky has received world-wide praise for his interpretations of the music of Sergei Rachmaninoff. In this wonderful recital, the great pianist presents works by the Russian Romantic composer as well as Ludwig van Beethoven and Alexander Glazunov. Lugansky opens his concert with Beethoven’s Piano Sonata No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 27 No. 2, ‘Moonlight’, followed by Alexander Glazunov’s Piano Sonata No.

programme.title: Heavenly Voices - The legacy of Farinelli
programme.desc: The documentary 'Heavenly Voices – The Legacy of Farinelli' (2012) tells us the story of the castrato in music – male singers who were castrated at a young age in order to preserve their high vocal range, a cruel practice that was in place mainly in the 17th and 18th centuries.

programme.title: Works by Mozart and Sarti
programme.desc: Italian conductor Mattia Rondelli conducts the Orchestra dell’Opera Carlo Felice Genova in a concert program consisting of works by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart and Giuseppe Sarti. Soprano Barbara Massaro is the soloist. On the program are Mozart’s Symphony No. 5 in B-flat major, K.

programme.title: Schubert - Rondo D. 951
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists. As part of this concert, Argerich and pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï perform Franz Schubert’s Rondo in A major, D. 951.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mahler - Das Lied von der Erde
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra in Gustav Mahler’s poignant song cycle ‘Das Lied von der Erde’ (The Song of the Earth). Joining him are two of today's leading vocalists: mezzo-soprano Magdalena Kožená and tenor Andrew Staples. Written in the final years of his life, Mahler’s masterpiece contemplates the beauty of life and the sorrow of parting through some of his most personal and beautiful symphonic writing.

programme.title: Copland - Appalachian Spring
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Aaron Copland’s Appalachian Spring Suite. Originally commissioned as a ballet for the legendary dancer Martha Graham, Aaron Copland's Appalachian Spring (1944) has since become an American classic. While first scored for a thirteen-piece ensemble, Copland later arranged the work for a full orchestra.

programme.title: House of Dreams
programme.desc: House of Dreams is an imaginative concert designed by Alison Mackay. The concert is a magical journey to the meeting places of baroque art and music - five European homes where exquisite works by Bach, Handel, Vivaldi, Purcell and Marais were played against a backdrop of paintings by Vermeer, Canaletto, and Watteau. Stage direction by Marshall Pynkoski and narrated by Blair Williams.

programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Semi-final I: Arisa Onoda
programme.desc: Pianist Arisa Onoda (Japan, 1996) joins the CMIM ensemble, consisting of three principal strings players of the Montreal Symphony Orchestra, in a performance of the first movement, Allegro molto moderato, of Gabriel Fauré’s Piano Quartet No. 1 in C minor, Op. 15. This performance took place during the chamber music round of the two-part semi-final of the Piano Edition of the Concours musical international de Montréal 2024 (CMIM).

programme.title: The Pianists Keys
programme.desc: This documentary by Christoph Keller follows various participants and teachers participating in the International Summer Piano Academy.

programme.title: Approaching the Maelström
programme.desc: The 2019 documentary ‘Approaching the Maelström’ follows the process leading up to a recording of American composer Philip Glass’s composition ‘A Descent into the Maelström’. The work is based on American writer Edgar Allan Poe’s 1841 short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, Norway.

programme.title: Strauss - Piano Quartet in C minor, Op. 13
programme.desc: Violinist Daniel Rowland, violist Rachel Roberts, cellist Julian Arp, and pianist Diana Ketler perform Richard Strauss’s Piano Quartet in C minor, Op. 13, as part of the Stiftfestival 2016 in the Dutch village of Weerselo. In his early years, Strauss tried to compose different types of chamber music works, including a piano quartet.

programme.title: Brahms - Symphony No. 2, Op. 73
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker, Daniel Barenboim and Claudio Abbado star at the Europakonzert 1994 in Meiningen, Germany, performing Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 5 and Johannes Brahms’ Symphony No. 2. Popularly known as the Emperor Concerto and composed in Vienna between 1809 and 1811, Piano Concerto No. 5 is Beethoven’s last completed piano concerto and often performed by star pianists such as Daniel Barenboim.

programme.title: Works by Mendelssohn and Hensel
programme.desc: The extraordinarily talented pianist Elena Bashkirova has been president of the Felix Mendelssohn-Bartholdy Foundation in Leipzig since October 2020, succeeding legendary conductor Kurt Masur.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 1, Op. 15
programme.desc: At the age of seven, Martha Argerich made her debut with Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 1, a piece that would accompany her throughout her career. In this concert at the Lucerne Festival, the celebrated pianist performs the signature piece with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra under the baton of Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt, who made his debut here with the orchestra.

programme.title: Berlioz - The Damnation of Faust
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle and the London Symphony Orchestra mark 150 years since the death of Hector Berlioz with his tempestuous oratorio, La damnation de Faust. La damnation de Faust is a work born of the composer’s obsession with Goethe’s legendary tale. Once a righteous scholar, Faust allows himself to be corrupted by the devil, and drags the innocent around him into desperation and death.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Overture-Fantasy Romeo and Juliet
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Overture-Fantasy “Romeo and Juliet”. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland’s best-known orchestras. Tchaikovsky based his composition on Shakespeare’s famous play “Romeo and Juliet”.

programme.title: Les Saltimbanques
programme.desc: In 2021, Kader Belarbi, choreographer and director of dance of the Théâtre du Capitole de Toulouse, brought his 1998 ballet ‘Les Saltimbanques’ back to the stage. Inspired by Pablo Picasso’s painting ‘Famille de saltimbanques’ (Family of Saltimbanques, 1905) and the fifth of German poet Rainer Maria Rilke’s ‘Duino Elegies’ (1922), Belarbi animates the company of acrobats from Picasso’s canvas, bringing circus and dance together.

programme.title: Rina Sala Gallo Piano Competition 2022 - Finalists
programme.desc: The Rina Sala Gallo International Piano Competition takes place every two years in the Italian city of Monza. Founded in 1947 by Monza-born pianist Rina Sala Gallo and Brescia-born pianist Arturo Benedetti Michelangeli, the competition is one of Monza’s most prestigious cultural events today.

programme.title: Mahler - Songs on the Death of Children
programme.desc: Mahler's Kindertotenlieder (Songs on the Death of Children) is a deeply personal song cycle for voice and orchestra inspired by Friedrich Rückert's poems about the loss of his children. The work's emotional depth comes from its unflinching portrayal of grief through a powerful juxtaposition of natural imagery and intimate parental pain.

programme.title: Chopin - Nocturnes Op. 62
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Stravinsky - Le Sacre - II: Le Sacrifice
programme.desc: Every year, the Europakonzert is hosted by the Berliner Philharmoniker in a notorious concert hall or on a special location. This years concert is performed at the magnificent Royal Albert Hall in London. The Dutch conductor Bernard Haitink closes with Stravinsky's The Rite of Spring which he wrote in 1913 for Sergei Diaghilev's Ballets Russes.

programme.title: Cartoons in Concert
programme.desc: It's going to be fast, really fast! All your favourite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the Concert Hall - together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras. Cartoons are for children and adults alike - and the music in them is at least as entertaining as the pictures!

programme.title: Divas and Diamonds
programme.desc: Musicians of the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, the DR Big Band, and the Danish National Vocal Ensemble join forces under the baton of Klaus To¨nshoff in this dazzling concert featuring great songs from black and white cinema.

programme.title: Dvorák – Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 1–8)
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in Antonín Dvorák’s spirited Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 1-8). These 16 folk dances earned Dvorák, who was a relative newcomer when he wrote them, great success. Originally composed for piano four hands, the London Symphony Orchestra plays the orchestral version of these brilliant works. This performance was recorded at LSO St.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Richard Strauss - A Hero's Life, Op. 40
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Ein Heldenleben, Op. 40. Violin soloist is David Radzynski. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in February 2023. Strauss, at the age of 34, sparked outrage when he cast himself as the central figure of his tone poem. Generally agreed to be autobiographical, the work contains more than thirty quotations from Strauss's earlier works.

programme.title: Glass - A Descent into the Maelström
programme.desc: ‘A Descent into the Maelström’ (1841) is American writer Edgar Allan Poe’s short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, inside the Arctic Circle of northern Norway. After a treacherous whirlpool drags their boat down, only one of them survives. American composer Philipp Glass based his choral work for the Australian Dance Theatre on this story.

programme.title: Modena - City of Belcanto
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Handel - The Triumph of Time and Truth
programme.desc: Emmanuelle Haim conducts Le Concert d’Astrée in a rendition of G. F. Handel’s two-part oratorio “Il Trionfo del Tempo e del Disinganno” (The Triumph of Time and Truth). The work with a libretto by Benedetto Pamphili was first performed in Rome, in 1707. Director Krzysztof Warlikowski has taken Handel’s first oratorio, written when the composer was only 22 years old, on in a deep, tender staging.

programme.title: Ravel - La Valse
programme.desc: The exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a performance of Maurice Ravel’s La Valse, in an arrangement for two pianos. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Final: Schumann, Sibelius a. o.
programme.desc: Baritone Arvid Fagerfjäll (Sweden, 1991) and pianist Hikaru Kanki (Japan, 1993) perform ‘Lust der Sturmnacht’ from Robert Schumann’s Kerner-Lieder, Op. 35; ‘Le diable dans la nuit’ from Henriëtte Bosmans’ Dix mélodies; Franz Schubert’s Totengräbers Heimweh, D.

programme.title: De Falla - El sombrero de tres picos - Suite No. 2
programme.desc: During the New Year’s Gala 2010, the Berlin Philharmonic perform under the baton of Gustavo Dudamel, whose infectious energy and exceptional artistry have made him one of the most sought-after conductors by orchestras and opera companies around the world. They welcome mezzo-soprano Elina Garanca, who has become one of the world’s most famous singers within just a few years.

programme.title: Works for violin and piano by Corelli, Ravel a.o.
programme.desc: Japanese violinist Naoya Nishimura and Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti perform an intimate recital recorded at the Munetsugu Hall in Nagoya, Japan. On the program are Arcangelo Corelli’s Violin Sonata in D minor, Op. 5 No. 12, “La Folia”; Ludwig van Beethoven’s Violin Sonata No. 5 in F major, Op.

programme.title: Mozart - Quintet for piano and winds, K. 452
programme.desc: Luca Vignali (oboe), Angelo De Angelis (clarinet), Carmine Pinto (horn), Eliseo Smordoni (bassoon), and Linda Di Carlo (piano) perform Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Quintet for piano and winds in E-flat major, K. 452. The work premiered at the Viennese Burgtheater on April 1, 1784, with the composer himself at the piano. Shortly after the performance, Mozart wrote to his father Leopold, “I consider it the best work I have ever written…”.

programme.title: Patmos – A musical documentary
programme.desc: Every summer, the Greek island of Patmos hosts the Patmos Musical Festival, a unique musical event comprising both a Chamber and a Sacred Music Festival. This documentary captures the 2024 edition, featuring performances by distinguished soloists and ensembles from around the world.

programme.title: Schumann - Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz performs Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26 (Carnival Scenes from Vienna).

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam, the Octopus Symphonic Choir, and four vocal soloists in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Symphony No. 9 in D Minor, Op. 125 at De Doelen, Rotterdam, in 2019. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland's best-known orchestras. Beethoven’s Symphony No.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Esa-Pekka Salonen
programme.desc: The Finnish composer and conductor Esa-Pekka Salonen (1958) was Music Director of the Los Angeles Philharmonic from 1992 until 2009. Under his dynamic leadership, it was recognized as one of the world's most outstanding orchestras. The exciting musical partnership Salonen established with his musicians was widely acclaimed in the international press.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 1 in G minor, Op. 13
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen leads Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 1 in G minor, Op. 13, ‘Winter Daydreams’, recorded at De Doelen in Rotterdam, the Netherlands in September 2022. Having completed a number of shorter orchestral works, Tchaikovsky embarked on a more ambitious project in March 1866: to write his first symphony.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - Piano Concerto No. 2, Op. 22
programme.desc: Pianist Mikhail Pletnev is accompanied by the Russian National Orchestra led by Kirill Karabits in a performance of Camille Saint-Saëns's Piano Concerto No. 2, Op. 22. At its premiere in 1868, the orchestra was led by Anton Rubinstein, with the composer himself at the piano. The current concert was recorded at the Moscow Philharmonic Society and opens with a performance of Sergei Prokofiev's symphonic picture 'Dreams'.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - The Carnival of the Animals
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Camille Saint-Saëns’s musical suite The Carnival of the Animals (Le carnaval des animaux, 1886). This suite consists of 14 movements, each depicting a different animal.

programme.title: Handel - Messiah, HWV 56
programme.desc: The Messiah (HWV 56) by Georg Frederich Handel, also known as “A New Sacred Oratorio”, tells the life and suffering of Christ: a story of passion, fire, and sacrifice. This is one of Handel's best-known works, which took only three weeks to compose this oratorio and its famous 'Hallelujah'. The work has immense popularity since its premiere in Dublin in 1742, and is often presented at Easter.

programme.title: Bruckner - Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: In a 2019 performance from the Muziekgebouw in Eindhoven, Hartmut Haenchen conducts the philharmonie zuidnederland for this performance of Anton Bruckner’s Symphony No. 7.

programme.title: Works by Beethoven and Saint-Saëns
programme.desc: In May and June 2021, Argentinian star pianist Martha Argerich celebrated her 80th birthday performing at Château de Chantilly, France. In this concert, recorded at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, Argerich is joined by three musicians who are particularly close to her heart: cellist Mischa Maisky, violinist Maxim Vengerov, and pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï.

programme.title: Schumann - Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13. Composed between 1834-37, the work began as a theme and a set of sixteen variations.

programme.title: Chopin - Piano Concerto No. 2, Op. 21
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performance of Frédéric Chopin's Piano Concerto No. 2, Op. 21. Evgeny Kissin features as the soloist. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010. Chopin composed the second concerto one year before the Concerto No. 1 and completed both works at the age of 20, before leaving his home country Poland and moving to Paris.

programme.title: Live in Aix-en-Provence
programme.desc: The shy and elusive Grigroy Sokolov is one of the greatest pianists of our time. His performances leave critics and audiences alike speechless, like they don't quite believe what they have just experienced. In 2015, he played a beautiful recital with works by Johann Sebastian Bach, Ludwig van Beethoven, Franz Schubert, Frédéric Chopin, and Claude Debussy that took place at the Festival La Roque D'Anthéron in Aix-en-Provence.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020’s Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven’s celebrated Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, “Eroica”. The sprightly Swedish conductor celebrated his 93rd birthday just one month before this performance. This remarkable performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: In the Organ's Stomach
programme.desc: Olivier Latry is the current holder of the Great Organ of Notre Dame. Between its original religious function and the interest of composers of all times, the great organ Cavaillé-Coll reveals its absolute modernity. Latry is considered one of the greatest organists of his generation, both in France and internationally.

programme.title: A Tribute to Vienna
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna in this March 9, 2011 concert from Vienna's Café Sperl. The ensemble, which consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic, performs arrangements of five popular waltzes by Johann Straus II. Among them are Kaiser-Walzer, Op. 437, and Schatz-Walzer, Op. 418, from the operetta The Gypsy Baron.

programme.title: Barbara Hannigan at Severance Hall
programme.desc: Barbara Hannigan, soprano and conductor, won the Grammy for “Best Classical Solo Vocal Album CRAZY GIRL CRAZY (Gershwin, Berg and Berio) 2018 and took home the Grammy for “Artist of the Year” in 2022. In autumn 2023 she made her long-awaited conducting debut with the Cleveland Orchestra. The programme featured an interesting mix of old and new with Haydn´s Symphony No.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 25 And Symphony No. 35
programme.desc: Stefano Conticello leads the Orchestra of Teatro Comunale di Bologna in a Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart program. The concert opens with the Overture from Mozart’s popular opera “The Magic Flute”. This is followed by Piano Concerto No. 25 in C major, K. 503, with Maurizio Baglini as the featured soloist. Mozart’s Piano Concerto No. 25 is just one of the twelve great piano concertos he composed during 1784 and 1786.

programme.title: The Unanswered Ives
programme.desc: “The Unanswered Ives” is the first documentary about American modernist composer Charles Ives (1874-1954). Ives was among the first generation of American composers that achieved international acclaim. Born in 1874, in Danbury, Connecticut, Ives took music lessons at a young age, becoming a church organist at the age of 14.

programme.title: Mozart, Mendelssohn And Gershwin for 2 Pianos
programme.desc: Italian pianists Roberto Prosseda and Alessandra Ammara perform W. A. Mozart's Sonata for two pianos in D major, K. 488, Felix Mendelssohn's Sonata for two pianos in D major, MWV S 1, and George Gershwin's Rhapsody in Blue, during an off-season concert recorded at Fazioli Concert Hall in Sacile, Italy in June 26, 2020.

programme.title: Minha Terra Minha Gente
programme.desc: 'Minha Terra, Minha Gente' apresenta o melhor dos 308 concelhos do território, através da tradição, da inovação e da sustentabilidade. São empolgantes histórias de vida que personificam o amor à terra. Memórias das pessoas e dos locais, para as gerações futuras, com testemunhos marcantes e inspiradores de gente apaixonada: usos, costumes e tradições do rico património de Portugal.

programme.title: Feira Semanal: Espinho
programme.desc: 'Feira Semanal' é o programa onde Portugal se encontra. De tenda em tenda, nas vilas e cidades, seguimos o som dos pregões, sentimos o calor das conversas e o encanto das tradições que resistem ao tempo. Cada episódio é uma viagem ao coração do comércio popular, onde se pode vender a granel, som sorrisos, histórias e sabores locais.

programme.desc: Com o Mercury de 1950 arranjado, o resto do trabalho pode começar. A equipa faz uma operação para ligar o velho tejadilho com a nova geometria do corpo.

programme.desc: Os mineiros do Yukon voltam a arriscar tudo na esperança de fazerem fortuna. Com novos mineiros, novos terrenos e novas máquinas, a fasquia nunca esteve tão alta.

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T10 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: Os mineiros do Yukon voltam a arriscar tudo na esperança de fazerem fortuna. Com novos mineiros, novos terrenos e novas máquinas, a fasquia nunca esteve tão alta.

programme.title: Aquários XXL T7 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Dwight Howard, lenda de basquetebol, precisa que os rapazes lhe criem e construam um habitat para as suas 14 cobras. E ele quer uma mansão para répteis!

programme.title: À Pesca De Ouro T10 - Ep. 5

programme.title: À Pesca De Ouro T10 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: É um momento importante para Shawn quando o Myrtle Irene é colocado na água. Steve continua à procura de emprego e Kris parte numa aventura arriscada.

programme.title: À Pesca De Ouro T10 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Em conversa com o pai, Shawn põe as cartas na mesa quanto ao futuro da mina do interior. Vernon incentiva os seus mergulhadores com uma viagem de luxo a Las Vegas.

programme.title: Expedição X T3 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Moradores horrorizados do Iowa dizem ter visto uma criatura alada gigante: o mesmo monstro que aterrorizou a cidade de Van Meter há 100 anos.

programme.title: Expedição X T3 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Phil e Jess ganham acesso exclusivo para investigar vozes e aparições fantasmagóricas no Fort Morgan, uma fortaleza da Guerra Civil.

programme.title: Expedição X T3 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Jess e Phil mergulham mais fundo na história trágica de Fort Morgan. Amy Bruni e Adam Berry juntam-se a eles para investigar.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T25 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são analisados ao microscópio. Como é que se fazem esculturas de verga ou a torragem de café?

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T25 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são analisados ao microscópio. Como são feitas as lixadoras de cilindros e as litografias?

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T25 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são analisados ao microscópio. Como é que os calissons e os watercrafts de mergulho são feitos?

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T25 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são analisados ao microscópio. Como é que as mesas de jogo e os candeeiros de parede de vidro artístico são feitos?

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T25 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são analisados ao microscópio. Como é que os sabonetes de Marselha e os canivetes de bolso Laguiole são feitos?

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T25 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são analisados ao microscópio. Como é que os licores de canela e as limas caseiras são feitos?

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T25 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Mais objetos do quotidiano são analisados ao microscópio. Como é que objetos do quotidiano, incluindo boinas, bebidas alcoólicas aromatizadas e bicicletas elípticas são feitos?

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T3 - Ep. 39
programme.desc: Alguma vez se perguntou como é que os objetos quotidianos são feitos? Este programa vai dizer-lhe tudo! Para rapazes que gostam de brincar com os seus brinquedos.

programme.title: Caçadores De Pedras Preciosas: Austrália T2 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Ray começa a lascar e serrar as pedras maiores em bruto. Os Bushies acreditam que finalmente vão fazer fortuna. Mas será só um sonho?

programme.title: Joias Sobre Rodas T16 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Mike Brewer, negociante de carros, e Ant Anstead, multitalentoso mecânico, têm a missão de encontrar e restaurar carros icónicos para depois os vender na sua oficina de LA.

programme.title: Joias Sobre Rodas T15 - Ep. 24

programme.title: Shed And Buried T4 - Ep. 12

programme.title: Shed And Buried T4 - Ep. 13

programme.title: Shed And Buried T4 - Ep. 14

programme.title: Regresso Às Origens T7 - Ep. 6

programme.title: Iron Resurrection T3 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: A última criação de Joe, um Nova de '71, está atrasado e ainda há muito a fazer. Conseguirá terminar a sua parte do trabalho, por dentro e por fora, a tempo?

programme.title: O Jogo Do Destino - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 61
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 61
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Jogo Do Destino - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Don Cherry's 'Multikulti'
programme.desc: Trumpeter Don Cherry was a musician of great versatility, creating an endless variety of styles and influencing generations of musicians. Multikulti presents a never-before heard mixture of international sounds, from mainstream jazz to reggae, in his first collaboration with the amazing Peter Apfelbaum, one of the most in-demand performers at jazz festivals all over the world.

programme.title: Brazilian NYE
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the artists taking part in this series is Paulo Novaes.

programme.title: Fats Domino - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. American singer and pianist Fats Domino gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival of 1980.

programme.title: George Shearing: The South Bank Show
programme.desc: George Shearing, blind since birth, is one of the world's greatest jazz pianists. Filmed on both sides of the Atlantic, this tribute to Shearing showcases the music which took the jazz world by storm.

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz à Vienne is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981, it has attracted a mix of jazz legends and exciting newcomers, with many of them playing return engagements. Each year welcomes outstanding international stars to the historical Le Théâtre Antique to impress and inspire their audiences. In 2018, English trip-hop group Morcheeba performed at Jazz à Vienne.

programme.title: Frank Paavo Quintet feat. Joris Teepe - Café Miles
programme.desc: Saxophonist Frank Paavo has been active on the jazz scene of Amsterdam and the Netherlands since the early 1980s. His music is inspired by the hard-bop sounds of the late 1950s and early 1960s, full of positive energy, rhythmic intensity, and good old-fashioned swing. Among Paavo’s major influences are Wayne Shorter and Charles Mingus.

programme.title: Rumble
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Clear Ways
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Anita Oday Live in Sweden 1963
programme.desc: Anita O’Day?boasts two wonderful concerts from 1963 and 1970 that present the “jazz singer supreme” in impeccable form. O’Day’s horn-based approach to singing is in full effect throughout both shows including stand-out renditions in each show of audience favorites “Tea For Two” and “Sweet Georgia Brown” (both reprised from her triumphant appearance at the 1958 Newport Jazz Festival.

programme.title: Morgenland: Songs Without Frontiers
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects.

programme.title: Lionel Hampton Big Band - Kurhaus Scheveningen
programme.desc: The Kurhaus in Scheveningen is a grand hotel in the Netherlands renowned for attracting both royal and musical nobility. Doubling as a concert hall, it has been host to several heavy hitters, such as the Rolling Stones and Ike and Tina Turner. On August 2, 1983, American vibraphonist Lionel Hampton performed at the Kurhaus in Scheveningen.

programme.title: Christian McBride - John Day
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, RAndB, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical.

programme.title: Kenny Barron, Song for Abdullah
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet).

programme.title: Germeringer Jazztage: Paco de Lucía And Group
programme.desc: This broadcast shows a rare appearance at the 1996 Germeringer Jazztage by the legendary flamenco guitarist Paco de Lucía and his sextet. Some may question the inclusion of a flamenco guitarist within a jazz festival.

programme.title: Tivoli Utrecht: Sven Hammond Soul
programme.desc: Although its music might sound like the sound track of any 1970s American car chase movie, the band Sven Hammond Soul is from the Netherlands. This steaming soul machine is headed by Sven Figee, who prefers to attack rather than play his Hammond organ. In April 2012, the band was augmented with vocalist Jenny Lane. Today’s recordings were made at a steaming live performance at Utrecht’s Tivoli in 2012.

programme.title: Horace Silver - Song for my father
programme.desc: Embark on a remarkable journey through the world of jazz piano as we showcase some of the most iconic and influential pianists in history. This collection of extraordinary performances captures the unique essence and brilliance of legendary pianists Art Tatum, Thelonious Monk, Bud Powell, and others. Revel in Oscar Peterson’s virtuosity as his trio plays “C-Jam Blues” in Holbaek, Denmark, on May 2, 1964.

programme.title: Free Jazz in Kongressaal Munich: Cecil Taylor
programme.desc: In the midst of the blossoming of the free-jazz scene, pianist Cecil Taylor (1929) probably represented the non-jazz aspect of the movement better than anyone else. Many of the innovations of the 1960s were pioneered by his records. His fusion of exuberance and atonality was particularly influential.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Boogieball with The NPG and Questlove
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: Live at A to JazZ Festival, Sofia
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music”; an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content.

programme.title: Makoto Ozone - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1984, Japanese jazz pianist Makoto Ozone was one of the artists appearing here.

programme.title: Live at Bimhuis Amsterdam
programme.desc: Dutch free jazz, jazz rock, and electronic music pioneer Pierre Courbois threw a belated 80th birthday bash at Amsterdam’s renowned BIMhuis in January 2022. Courbois, a celebrated drummer and percussionist, also masters the tabla, conga, bass guitar, and vibraphone, and is a prolific writer with over 100 compositions to his credit.

programme.title: Gonzalo Rubalcaba Trio - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1994, Cuban pianist Gonzalo Rubalcaba was one of the artists appearing here.

programme.title: Art Blakey Live in 1965
programme.desc: Art Blakey: Live in '65 features a very impressive lineup from jazz history: Art Blakey (drums), Jaki Byard (piano), Reggie Workman (bass), Nathan Davis (sax), and the legendary trumpet player, Freddie Hubbard. For a fall tour of Europe, Blakey assembled The New Jazzmen, a short-lived quintet that performed this legendary concert at La Mutualité in Paris on November 3, 1965.

programme.title: Schloss Ansbach: Ornette Coleman Sextet
programme.desc: ‘Harmolodics’, the musical philosophy of jazz saxophonist Ornette Coleman, is associated primarily with avant-garde jazz and the free jazz movement, although its implications extend beyond these limits. Coleman defined ‘harmolodics’ as “the use of the physical and the mental of one's own logic made into an expression of sound to bring about the musical sensation of unison executed by a single person or with a group”.

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz à Vienne is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981, it has attracted a mix of jazz legends and exciting newcomers, with many of them playing return engagements. Each year welcomes outstanding international stars to the historical Le Théâtre Antique to impress and inspire their audiences.

programme.title: F.B. Orch., B.E. Ba., T.J. and M.L. Ba. - Newport
programme.desc: In 1968 traden het orkest van de Belgische pianist Francy Boland, de band van de Nederlandse trompettist Boy Edgar en de Amerikaanse band van trompettist Thad Jones en drummer Mel Lewis op tijdens het Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam.

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz à Vienne is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981, it has attracted a mix of jazz legends and exciting newcomers, with many of them playing return engagements. Each year welcomes outstanding international stars to the historical Le Théâtre Antique to impress and inspire their audiences.

programme.title: Ray Charles - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Chick Corea - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Bakolo Music International - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Joe Zawinul - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. In 1985, Viennese keyboardist Joe Zawinul was one of the artists appearing at this festival.

programme.title: Michelle David - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. The talented American singer Michelle David performs pop and gospel music that feeds the heart and soothes the soul. Having grown up with the church, she started singing at the age of four. A year later she joined her first band, The Mission of Love.

programme.title: Jazz à Ramatuelle: Kyle Eastwood Quintet
programme.desc: Bassist Kyle Eastwood (1968) is an explorer, equally at ease with jazz melodies as with pop songs. In the late 1970s, his father Clint took him to see his first jazz concert - a Count Basie performance. Eastwood Jr. was in awe of the drummer and wanted to play an instrument himself. It so happened he wasn’t so much interested in jazz, preferring rhythm and blues, Motown and Stax records, funk groups, and North African and Indian music.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: O.P. Trio and E. Fitz. - Jazz At The Philharmonic
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On May 5, 1957, jazz impresario Norman Granz presented his Jazz at the Philharmonic tour at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.title: Teddy Wilson - Théâtre de l’Atelier
programme.desc: Decades after the 1930s swing era came to an end, one of its giants, pianist Teddy Wilson (1912–1986), kept the flame of this music alive during countless international concert tours. During a hectic spring tour of Europe, the acclaimed pianist appeared at Geneva’s Théâtre de l’Atelier on March 21, 1969.

programme.title: Michel Legrand Orchestra at Spa, 1982
programme.desc: Known outside jazz circles mainly for his film scores, French composer, arranger and pianist Michel Legrand has had a long and storied career in music. Interpreters of his compositions include jazz legends such as Sarah Vaughan, Stan Getz, and Bill Evans, as well as pop stars such as Barbra Streisand and Frank Sinatra.

programme.title: On Piano
programme.desc: Jazz first gained a foothold on Latvian soil in the 1920s. A century onward, this documentary traces the first two decades of jazz in Latvia in this portrait of Jack Michalicky, the first known Latvian jazz pianist. Michalicky was a musician from head to toe – a gifted violinist, he truly felt at home at the piano. Slender and lithe, the imaginative pianist’s fingers flew across the keys like a true miracle.

programme.title: Obatalà
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2’ to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Bata´’. The bata´ repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valde´s’ piano solos throughout the concert.

programme.title: John Coltrane
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist’s career.

programme.title: Kurhaus Scheveningen: Beets And Rosenwinkel
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Tania Maria Trio - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: NSJ Vocal Selection: Carter, O'Day and Benjamin
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Carlinhos Brown
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Walter Trout Band - Jazzwoche Burghausen
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: Salomao Soares Trio - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: Da Pá Virada sessions bring the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor.

programme.title: Ode to Miles: Bitches Brew Beyond
programme.desc: For the 40th anniversary of jazz legend Miles Davis' legendary album Bitches Brew, trumpeter Wallace Roney leads a band that revives the master's music. This project is the brainchild of Miles' family (including his son Erin), which is represented by his nephew, drummer Vince Wilburn. This concert at the ancient theater in Vienne, France, is a grand tribute to Miles.

programme.title: Bill Evans And The Spykillers
programme.desc: American jazz saxophonist and two-time Grammy nominee Bill Evans plays at the legendary Parisian nightclub New Morning with Wolfgang Haffner (drums), Gary Grainger (bass) and Simon Oslender (keys), collectively known as The Spykillers. Naturally, a Bill Evans concert would not be complete without the song ‘Jean Pierre’, a French nursery song Evans recorded during his tenure with Miles Davis’s band in the 1980s.

programme.title: The New Conrad Miller Trio Live at Mocher's
programme.desc: Full-time pianist, composer, teacher, and producer Coen Molenaar – aka Conrad Miller – is active all over the world in styles ranging as widely as jazz, fusion, dance, funk, RAndB, rock, and neo-soul. In this 2021 performance from Rossini Studios in Stuttgart, Germany, Miller plays contemporary trio jazz with his bandmates David de Marez Oyens (double bass) and Enrique Firpi (drums).

programme.title: Gregory Porter - Jazz a Vienne
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne’ is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2012 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them was vocalist Gregory Porter transcends the jazz bubble.

programme.title: Portrait of Roy Ayers
programme.desc: ‘The legend of the groove’ is a series of documentaries devoted to the musicians who were most influential on contemporary hip hop, soul, rhythm 'n' blues, and on the course of history. Between the late 1950s and now, these musicians radically changed music. Although sometimes hardly in the public eye, they have all been major sources of inspiration for today's major artists: Prince, Erykah Badu, Janis Joplin and Jimi Hendrix.

programme.title: Marcus Strickland - The Middle Man
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, RAndB, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical.

programme.title: Jazzed Out London
programme.desc: Jazzed Out proves that a jazz session can take place anywhere. Unusual locations, such as garage buildings, multi-storey car parks, street corners, subway trains, and parks, in several of the world’s metropoles, provide the setting for brief jazz performances. The sheer rawness of the metropoles merge with the musical creations of various artists in search of the perfect ‘urban stage’.

programme.title: Bill Evans - Maison de la Radio
programme.desc: Bill Evans is considered one of the greatest jazz pianists all time and is known for interpreting the jazz repertoire using impressionistic harmonies. In 1958, Evans first played in Miles Davis’s sextet recording the modal jazz album “Kind of Blue”, which is now considered one of the best jazz albums of all time. After leaving the ensemble, Evans formed several trios.

programme.title: Monty Alexander Quartet - Noth Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: World-renowned American blues singer and guitarist Magic Slim performed an electrifying set at the French festival Jazz à Vienne 2012. With bandmates John McDonald (guitar And vocals), Andre Howard (bass), and Brian Jones (drums), the blues giant played a string of classic Chicago blues hits. Ever energetic, the veritable blues veteran put on a dynamic show for an enthusiastic audience in the atmospheric ancient Roman theatre of Vienne.

programme.title: Crossroads: From Highlife to Musette
programme.desc: A two-part documentary, narrated by Dee Dee Bridgewater. Part 2: From Highlife to Musette On the road where European and African music converge, we discover the diverse influences of Jazz and her offshoots that exist today. New styles and revivals of past traditions enrich Jazz and render it the essential element of our entire music culture.

programme.title: Great Guitarists - Collage
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends’ unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery’s virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year.

programme.title: Festival international de jazz Adolphe Sax
programme.desc: On June 4, 1962, the first Festival International de Jazz ‘Adolphe Sax’ took place in the Belgian town of Dinant, where Adolphe Sax, the inventor of the saxophone, was born in 1814. Not surprisingly, most artists on the program are saxophonists. A Belgian quartet, consisting of tenor saxophonist Jacques Bailly, guitarist Willy Donni, drummer Bruno Castellucci, and bassist José Bedeur, opens the festival.

Bonus coverage includes Jason Litzau, aka 'The American Boy' (20-1, 18 KOs) vs.

programme.title: Greatest Classics T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Hector 'Macho' Camacho, always entertaining and flamboyant, stepping into the ring with 62-4 Tony Menefee in Lincoln, Nebraska. Camacho was on the comeback trail, following an up and down year that saw him defeat the legendary Sugar Ray Leonard by TKO before dropping a unanimous decision to Oscar De La Hoya for the WBC Welterweight Title. With his eyes on another title shot he faces Menefee, in the midst of a 14-fight win streak.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! T1 - Ep. 39
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is Andre Berto defending the WBC welterweight title against former WBA champion Luis Collazo. Each fighter had their own share of getting stunned throughout the bout, and the judges' decision at the end will have some controversy. Also on the card, kickboxing takes center stage as super heavyweight legend Daniel Ghita takes on Gokhan Saki.

programme.title: FS Grand Sumo T34 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. Episode 3 from Fukuoka, Japan.

programme.title: Pariah: Sonny Liston T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Was Sonny Liston murdered? This four-part documentary series explores the life and untimely death of boxing legend Charles 'Sonny' Liston, who became the heavyweight champion of the world when he knocked out Floyd Patterson in 1962. Unfortunately, just eight years later, he was found dead in his Las Vegas home from an alleged heroin overdose. Suspicion regarding the real cause of his death has continued to this day. Episode 4 of 4.

programme.title: MMA:30 T1 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: This episode features ring girl Arianny Celeste making a high schooler's dreams come true when she goes as his date to his prom. Also, we catch up with Clay Guida and Urijah Faber at the LA Fit Expo and we go behind the scenes for an intimate photo shoot with beautiful ring girl Amber Nicole.

programme.title: FS MMA T5 - Ep. 3

programme.title: Capitaine Marleau
programme.desc: Une femme est retrouvée morte à bord du bac qui relie les deux berges du fleuve. Face à Marleau les pistes se multiplient : le coupable serait-il le jeune Argann, tout juste évadé de prison et qui avait des raisons d’en vouloir à la victime ? A-t-elle été tuée parce qu’elle milite contre la construction d’un pont qui scellerait la fin du bac?

programme.title: Ça Commence aujourd'hui
programme.desc: Tous les jours, Faustine BOLLAERT accueille sur le plateau de « Ca commence aujourd’hui » des hommes et des femmes qui viennent témoigner sur une période de leur vie, un drame, une épreuve, un cap à passer ou un changement, et qui font souvent écho à de grands sujets de société. Entourée d'experts : psychologues, psychiatres, avocats, gynécologue, Faustine aide les témoins et les téléspectateurs à mieux comprendre ce qu’ils ont vécu.

programme.title: Le Paris de Modigliani
programme.desc: Au tournant du XXe siècle jusqu’à la première guerre mondiale, l’insouciance dans la capitale est reine. Les progrès techniques progressent, les revendications ouvrières commencent à être satisfaites, les Parisiens s’amusent et la création artistique foisonne… Il faut dire que depuis l’Exposition Universelle de 1900, la capitale est devenue la « Ville lumière de la culture ».

programme.title: Sagesses Bouddhistes
programme.desc: Nous vous présentons, l’Institut d’Etudes Bouddhiques ou IEB, fondé il y a déjà 30 ans. Cette structure de formation unique en France, a pour mission d’enseigner de façon neutre tout ce qui concerne le Bouddhisme : histoire, courants, rites, iconographie, textes anciens, philosophie, arts et plus.

programme.title: Islam
programme.desc: Créée en 1983, « Islam » est une émission proposée par l'Association Vivre l’Islam. Ce rendez-vous hebdomadaire permet de faire connaître la troisième religion monothéiste de l’humanité en décryptant ses fondements, son message, ses valeurs, son histoire et sa civilisation.

programme.title: A l'origine Histoires
programme.desc: C’est au coeur même de l’Institut de France, dans la grande salle de la Coupole que François Sureau, membre de l’Académie Française, et le Grand rabbin de France Haïm Korsia, membre de l’Académie des sciences morales et politiques, échangent sur le franco judaïsme. Le franco-judaïsme est la spécificité de l’identité juive française : la conjugaison parfaite des valeurs du judaïsme et de la République française.

programme.title: Présence Protestante
programme.desc: Lorenzo Monge est aumônier militaire protestant. Il intervient sur la Région gendarmerie Île-de-France et plus spécifiquement avec les unités de gendarmerie du département de la Seine-et-Marne (77). Nous le suivons dans son quotidien d’accompagnement des gendarmes exerçant leur métier, que ce soit en patrouille, aux opérations de contrôle de vitesse/ alcoolémie/stupéfiants, à la prise de café dans les casernes, à l’entrainement...

programme.title: Un Métier Sérieux
programme.desc: C’est la rentrée. Une nouvelle année scolaire au collège qui voit se retrouver Pierre, Meriem, Fouad, Sophie, Sandrine, Alix et Sofiane, un groupe d’enseignants engagés et soudés. Ils sont rejoints par Benjamin, jeune professeur remplaçant sans expérience et rapidement confronté aux affres du métier. A leur contact, il va découvrir combien la passion de l’enseignement demeure vivante au sein d’une institution pourtant fragilisée.

programme.title: La Relève, une Année pour Devenir Prof
programme.desc: Salomé, Axel et Thomas font leur première rentrée au lycée Lucie Aubrac de Courbevoie. Jeunes, inexpérimentés, tout juste sortis des études, ils n’ont que quelques années de plus que leurs élèves. Animés par un profond désir de transmettre, leur vocation est brûlante. Mais elle va se heurter à la réalité d’un métier passionnant mais difficile, dans un contexte de crise profonde de l’éducation nationale.

programme.title: Une Petite École Française
programme.desc: Une année scolaire dans le quotidien d'une école : entre combat des profs et découragement citoyen, petits tracas du quotidien et grandes questions pédagogiques, mission d'inclusion et abandon politique. De la petite fuite d'eau à la question de la fermeture de classe en passant par la nouvelle grand mission de l'école, l'inclusion, le portrait tout au long d'une année scolaire d'une petite école Française, un monde que l'on croit...

programme.desc: Uma mulher divorciada e mãe de quatro filhos desaparece. Um caso de pessoas desaparecidas dá uma reviravolta quando familiares e amigos retratam a mulher de forma muito diferente.

programme.title: The Killer Beside Me T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Quando Alice Hufnagle é violada e assassinada em 2002, a Polícia começa por questionar o marido ausente. Mas as pistas levam até a um colega, na farmácia local.

programme.title: The Murder Tapes T6 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: A polícia de Akron encontra Dereke Alexander gravemente ferido, mas este não sobrevive. A investigação leva a polícia a assassinos que caçavam Dereke como presa.

programme.title: The Murder Tapes T6 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Donovan Barfield é encontrado morto e o seu apartamento é saqueado. Os detetives descobrem um plano diabólico de assassinato e roubo orquestrado por assassinos imprudentes.

programme.title: Shadow of Doubt T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Quando Michelle Warner, mãe de duas crianças, desaparece sem deixar rasto do seu apartamento, a Polícia suspeita que o passado dela tenha voltado à tona.

programme.title: Shadow of Doubt T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Uma popular chefe claque de liceu esgueira-se de sua casa pela janela, depois de ter discutido com a sua mãe. Dias depois, o seu corpo é encontrado a flutuar num rio.

programme.title: Still A Mystery T5 - Ep. 27
programme.desc: Uma dançarina é baleada em casa e os detetives tentam descobrir quem teria motivos para a matar. Um cigarro encontrado no local do crime pode dar respostas.

programme.title: Still A Mystery T5 - Ep. 28
programme.desc: Uma mãe desaparece de casa e a suspeita recai nos seus admiradores. Será que uma confissão-surpresa resolve o mistério?.

programme.title: Dead Reckoning T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Em Charlottesville, são encontrados os corpos de mãe e filha. Os detetives descobrem uma relação secreta virtual que pode ser a pista que os levará até ao assassino.

programme.title: Dead Reckoning T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Uma mãe solteira é encontrada morta num aparente cenário de suicídio. No entanto, a falta de uma arma na cena do crime leva a polícia a seguir um rasto de segredos obscuros.

programme.title: Disappeared T1 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Após o desaparecimento de Amy, a Polícia tem um suspeito, mas não tem uma cena de crime, um corpo, ou pistas. Mas, graças a um inesperado informante, o caso é resolvido.

programme.title: Disappeared T1 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Um astro do basquetebol e a sua namorada desaparecem quando velejavam. A Polícia tem de localizar o irmão do jogador, que é a única pessoa que pode saber o que se passou.

programme.title: What Happened At Fells Acres?
programme.desc: A cidade de Malden, no Massachusetts, fica indignada após uma criança numa creche familiar ter-se queixado de abuso sexual. As alegações aumentam com as queixas de mais crianças.

programme.title: What Happened To Valentino Dixon?
programme.desc: Um jovem na primavera da vida é morto a tiro, perante uma série de testemunhas. Porém, o que deveria ter sido um caso extremamente simples transforma-se numa teia de mistério.

programme.title: Mean Girl Murders T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Em 2015, Tiffany Boyer envolveu-se numa situação tensa numa festa, em Albuquerque. É dada como desaparecida e ninguém fala, mas um detetive descobre uma conspiração de vingança.

programme.title: Mean Girl Murders T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Depois que a doce e insegura Kelly Bullwinkle é encontrada morta num local remoto, os investigadores descobrem uma trama de ciúmes e mentiras entre as amizades.

programme.title: Swamp Murders T4 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: O corpo de Barbara Hefner é encontrado a flutuar nas águas do lago Folly. Enquanto procuravam o assassino, os detetives descobrem um caso amoroso secreto.

programme.title: Swamp Murders T4 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: O corpo de Beverly Jackson é encontrado dentro de um carro que é retirado de uma canal. A Polícia explora os seus relacionamentos, mas a solução vem de outro lado.

programme.title: The Dead Files T10 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Steve e Amy investigam a atividade sobrenatural que está a atormentar um casal de investigadores paranormais. Durante a noite, Amy tem uma sensação estranha.

programme.desc: Culross tem uma história misteriosa, conhecida pela implacável caça às bruxas. A equipa contacta com as almas torturadas dos acusados injustamente de terem um pacto com o diabo.

programme.title: Spooked Scotland T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: No geral, Edimburgo é considerada a cidade mais assombrada da Europa. Enterradas nas ruas de paralelepípedos da sua Old Town estão as misteriosas abóbadas esquecidas.

programme.title: The Ghost Town Terror T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Tim e Sapphire usam a hipnose para descobrir segredos do passado da família Broussard. Porém, o contacto com um espírito maligno impede a experiência.

programme.title: The Ghost Town Terror T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Tim conduz a sua equipa a um epicentro de sofrimento: a Old Montana State Prison. A experiência emocional leva Tim a invocar o demónio que ocupa o lugar mais alto: Belzebu.

programme.title: Spooked Scotland T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Culross tem uma história misteriosa, conhecida pela implacável caça às bruxas. A equipa contacta com as almas torturadas dos acusados injustamente de terem um pacto com o diabo.

programme.desc: Um homem condenado por assassinar um barman, após uma noite de sexo e drogas, insiste que é inocente. Agora, o irmão e a mulher pedem ajuda a Chris e a Fatima.

programme.title: Disappeared T1 - Ep. 11

programme.title: Suspicious Minds T1 - Ep. 5

programme.title: Suspicious Minds T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: A morte a tiro de um vereador municipal enfurece os políticos e o público. Muitos suspeitos são considerados até um homem misterioso contactar a polícia.

programme.title: Extreme Forensics T2 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: Michele Harris desapareceu dia 11 de setembro de 2001. Deixaria ela os seus filhos e o seu casamento? Manchas de sangue sugerem que Michele poderá ter tido um fim mais sinistro.

programme.title: Extreme Forensics T2 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: Quando uma rapariga de 19 anos desaparece numa comunidade do Minnesota para, a polícia vira-se para um físico solar, para identificar um assassino fascinado pelo fogo.

programme.title: The Curious Case Of Natalia Grace T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: A adoção de Natalia pelos Barnett, uma alegada órfã ucraniana de seis anos, transforma-se num pesadelo quando descobrem que ela não tem essa idade, nem essa nacionalidade.

programme.title: The Curious Case Of Natalia Grace T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Michael Barnett revela que Natalia tentou envenená-los. Porém, as inconsistências na história dos Barnett levam os investigadores a questionar de onde vem realmente a malvadez.

programme.title: Murder Under The Friday Night Lights T3 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Dois jogadores de futebol são mortos a tiro, abalando duas pequenas cidades do Texas. Porém, a tragédia só piora quando a comunidade fica a saber quem é o assassino.

programme.title: Murder Under The Friday Night Lights T3 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Um futebolista famoso é esfaqueado até à morte e, inicialmente, parece ser uma tragédia aleatória, mas os investigadores depressa desmascaram o plano de uma equipa invejosa.

programme.title: Nightmare Next Door T4 - Ep. 5

programme.title: Arnaques!
programme.desc: Un portail, un chien, une servitude de passage, des poubelles… Il suffit parfois d’un rien pour transformer une relation de voisinage en véritable guerre ouverte. Face à des situations parfois totalement bloquées, notre négociateur Hervé Pouchol tentera de rétablir le dialogue avant que les conflits ne deviennent irréversibles.

programme.title: Arnaques!
programme.desc: C’est la guerre entre ces deux voisins Dans un paisible village, Danielle et Romain s’affrontent à cause d’un droit de passage : cris, insultes, ils en sont même venus aux mains ! Qui a raison, qui a tort ? Le village a choisi son camp et la guerre est déclarée. HLM : voisins sous tension En Alsace, trois voisins d'un même immeuble ne se supportent plus à cause d'une querelle autour de l'entretien des parties communes.

programme.title: The Rookie - Le Flic De Los Angeles

programme.title: The Rookie - Le Flic De Los Angeles
programme.desc: Avis de tempête sur le poste de Mid-Wilshire : Smitty n'a pas suivi la nouvelle procédure d'enregistrement des pièces à conviction. Lucy, Tim, Wade et les agents doivent fouiller tous les cartons pour retrouver l'arme utilisée lors d'une agression. Wesley et Angela ne sont pas d'accord sur les priorités familiales et Bailey reçoit une proposition de poste à Washington.
